subject.title: feat(agents): composable termination algebra + GSAR grounding scorer

question: Should OpenClaw core accept library-only termination/GSAR primitives with no production caller, or should this stay in the linked feature issue until an owner-approved runtime integration and trusted-evidence contract exist?
rationale: The remaining blocker is product/API ownership, not a narrow code repair: the branch intentionally removed production wiring and now depends on allowlisting unused core modules.

options.title: Pause library-only core merge
options.body: Keep the linked issue as the tracker and do not merge this branch until the primitives have an owner-approved production seam or are removed from core.

options.title: Sponsor integrated contract
options.body: Approve a narrow runtime integration with trusted evidence and require the PR to remove the dead-code allowlist by making the modules actually used.

options.title: Accept experimental groundwork
options.body: Merge the unused core modules as internal groundwork and accept the maintenance and API-drift risk.

recommendation.title: Pause library-only core merge
recommendation.body: Keep the linked issue as the tracker and do not merge this branch until the primitives have an owner-approved production seam or are removed from core.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent sessions_send and dead-code cleanup history and were explicitly requested for review in the PR discussion.
